ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:6 ratio; dominant low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels covering ~85% of the visible surface with high-intensity (white/light-gray) localized streaks and spots covering ~15%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark-gray base; white linear streaks distributed across the left lobe; concentrated white patches around the median notch; yellowish-white clusters at the distal lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped indentation with an approximate 75-degree internal angle; depth is approximately 12% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serration across the entire horizontal span; pixel amplitudes of variations range from 3 to 15 pixels in depth from the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the trailing edge, ending in sharp upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized, high-contrast yellowish-white pixel clusters (barnacle colonizations) on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white, unaligned linear pixel disruptions; at least three parallel diagonal streaks on the left lobe and one prominent vertical streak on the inner right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular serration along the trailing edge boundary; visible barnacle colonization at the tips; high-contrast white rake marks on the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A secondary, deep U-shaped notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe, located approximately 150 pixels from the primary median notch.
